newsitem.title: USA: NAM urges Fed to stand pat on interest rates.
newsitem.headline: NAM urges Fed to stand pat on interest rates.

text.p: The board of directors of the National Association of Manufacturers Monday urged the Federal Reserve Board to leave rates unchanged when policymakers meet Tuesday.

A NAM survey of the trade group board, which includes chief executive officers from some of the country's largest corporations, found that 83 percent felt the threat of renewed inflation was so remote that an increase in interest rates was unwarranted.
"In the current economic climate, low unemployment has not translated into more inflationary pressure," NAM said.
